This file creates the Costa Rican map that includes the best-performing model types per municipality. It also counts the number of municipalities with each model type as their best-performing one.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)
library(corrgram)
```
```{r}
  cantones <- st_read(r"(C:\Users\nan\OneDrive\Documentos\ucr\practica profesiona\dengue-model\data\canton-shapes\UGEC_MGN_2022.shp)")
  cantones$COD_UGEC = as.numeric(cantones$COD_UGEC)
  cantones <- st_transform(cantones, 4326)
  
  cantones <- cantones |> 
    mutate(canton = case_when(COD_UGEC == 612 ~ 601, COD_UGEC == 613 ~ 607, .default = COD_UGEC)) |> 
    group_by(canton) |> 
    summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry)) |> 
    ungroup()

 #   select(c(canton, geometry, best_model)) 
```

# Function

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(cowplot)

plot_map_overall <- function(specific){

  #  Function that plots the best-performing model per municipality. 

  # Parameters
  #  ----
  #  dataframe: string
  #    specification of whether the train or test datasets are used 

  #  Returns
  #  ----
  #  Nothing, but it plots the map.
  
  best <- read.csv(r"(C:\Users\nan\OneDrive\Documentos\ucr\practica profesiona\dengue-recurrent-cr\data\metrics\overall_best_model.csv)")
  
  if (specific == TRUE) {
      best$best_model = as.factor(best$best_model)
      levels(best$best_model) = c("ARIMA", "ARIMAX", "LSTM GLOBAL", "HRF", "HXGB", "LSTM INDIVIDUAL", "RF", "XGB")
      colors1 = c("#D55E00", "#CC79A7", "#009E73", "#0072B2", "#D55E50", "#CC79D9", "#009C98", "#0072F9")
  } else {
      best$best_model = as.factor(best$recurrence)
      levels(best$best_model) = c("Non-recurrent", "Recurrent")
      colors1 = c("#D55E00", "#009E73")
    
  }

  best$canton[which(best$canton == "-202")] = 202
  
  cantones <- st_read(r"(C:\Users\nan\OneDrive\Documentos\ucr\practica profesiona\dengue-model\data\canton-shapes\UGEC_MGN_2022.shp)")
  cantones$COD_UGEC = as.numeric(cantones$COD_UGEC)
  cantones <- st_transform(cantones, 4326)
  
  cantones <- cantones |> 
    mutate(canton = case_when(COD_UGEC == 612 ~ 601, COD_UGEC == 613 ~ 607, .default = COD_UGEC)) |> 
    group_by(canton) |> 
    summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry)) |> 
    ungroup()
  
  cant_best <- left_join(cantones, best, by = "canton") |> 
    select(c(canton, geometry, best_model)) 

  cv_xmin <- -84.5
  cv_xmax <- -83.8
  cv_ymin <-  9.8
  cv_ymax <- 10.15

  zoom_box <- data.frame(
    xmin = cv_xmin, xmax = cv_xmax,
    ymin = cv_ymin, ymax = cv_ymax
  )

  main_map <- ggplot(cant_best) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = best_model), color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_sf_text(
        aes(label = canton), 
        size = 2.8,           
        color = "black", 
        fontface = "bold",
        check_overlap = TRUE
      ) + 
    geom_rect(data = zoom_box, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
              color = "#F0E442", fill = NA, linewidth = 1.25, linetype = "dashed") +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(-86, -82), ylim = c(8, 11.4), expand = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Best Model", values = colors1) + 
    theme_void() +                                        
    theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right"                           
    )

  inset_map <- ggplot(cant_best) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = best_model), color = "white", size = 0.2) +
    geom_sf_text(
        aes(label = canton), 
        size = 2.8,            
        color = "black", 
        fontface = "bold",
        check_overlap = TRUE
      ) + 
    coord_sf(xlim = c(cv_xmin, cv_xmax), ylim = c(cv_ymin, cv_ymax), expand = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors1) + 
    theme_void() +                                        
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray40", fill = NA, size = 1),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none" 
    )

  final_plot <- ggdraw(main_map) +
    draw_plot(inset_map, x = 0.05, y = 0.05, width = 0.38, height = 0.38)
  
  final_plot

#  ggsave(
#    filename = paste0(r"(..\2_results\figures\best_)_models_map.png"),
#    plot = final_plot,
#    width = 10,  
#    height = 8,
#    dpi = 300
#  )
}
```
